items.title: 08:10 · Using the word racism to re-label private
items.detail: Using the word racism to re-label private prejudice wastes a structural term on a psychological construct that Allport, Fiske, and Greenwald had already named with precision.

items.title: 08:20 · In the book s architecture racism is
items.detail: In the book's architecture, racism is psycho-legal social software, a fractal mind virus that recruits host wetware biases and compiles them into law, property relations, and state coercion.

items.title: 08:31 · Separating the biological host wetware from the
items.detail: Separating the biological host wetware from the institutional software allows us to track how a universal cognitive tendency is captured and weaponized by an extraction regime.
